contract: POST /api/studio/configuration/experiments/convert; existing owner authorization and CSRF; explicit dataset/evaluator/agent revisions and pass threshold; native draft only.

browser.reason: The browser permission gate denied the disposable localhost origin before navigation. No alternate browser or permission workaround was attempted.

validation.example: Bundled synthetic declaration converted, planned and saved with four planned target executions and no run started.
validation.static: Affected Python lint/format, operations.js syntax and diff whitespace checks pass.
validation.live_provider: Not used. Injected synthetic target and judge exercised repeats and reference isolation.

guarantees: Authorization precedes conversion; existing CSRF is enforced
No discovery, provider call, plan, resource save or activation during conversion
Selected current resource revisions must match exactly
Copied cases and evaluator settings remain independent of source edits
Existing checks and expected responses remain intact; expected responses reach only the judge
Reimport retains prior suites and advances the experiment through reviewed native revisions
Duplicate YAML keys, aliases, unsupported settings and stale bindings reject without saving
Separate explicit conversion review, save-plan review and save actions
limits: Exactly one evaluator matching the primary evaluator; no multi-evaluator aggregation
Only integer maxWorkers: 1; the reference declaration's maxWorkers: 4 rejects explicitly
Sequential native execution, 1-20 repetitions, 1-4 variants and 400 target executions maximum
Target and execution dependencies are pinned when a run queues, not permanently frozen at import
Canonical native export only; external-format experiment export remains pending
Visual browser, physical-mobile and account-dependent grading acceptance remain pending
migration: No persisted-record migration; existing experiment and configuration formats retain their behavior.
next: Native bounded experiment worker concurrency with cancellation, checkpoint recovery and no replay before accepting maxWorkers > 1.
